mpn: LILYGO TTGO T-Display V1.1 (ESP32-D0WDQ6, 1.14 inch ST7789V TFT); EasyEDA symbol and footprint: copies of 2541FV-2x12P (C18722937), rebuilt
package: module 25.09 × 51.49 mm on two 1×12 pin headers, row spacing 22.86 mm; holes 1.1 mm, pads 1.7 mm
jlc_class: stand-in: not orderable as such – the T-Display is bought separately (not at LCSC/JLCPCB)

8.name: IO39
8.hint: input only, no internal pull; ESP32 errata 3.11: short pull-down glitches while the ADC/RTC runs

11.name: IO36
11.hint: input only, no internal pull; ESP32 errata 3.11: short pull-down glitches while the ADC/RTC runs

16.name: IO12
16.hint: MTDI: high at reset selects 1.8 V flash – the module does not boot

*.source: tail of a 2.54 mm female header 1x12 (the module plugs into it): usually 0.64 mm square – assumption like the Nano's (D-7)

compliance.source: Espressif ESP32 datasheet v5.3 (2026-07), table 5-6 Wi-Fi radio: operating frequency range 2412-2484 MHz (channel centres 1-14, set by software: 'Device should operate in the frequency range allocated by regional regulatory authorities'), TX power 11b mode 18.5/19.5/20.5 dBm min/typ/max, 11n MCS7 12-14 dBm, 'Target TX power is configurable'; table 5-12 Bluetooth LE: power control range -12 to +9 dBm; Bluetooth/BLE channels 2402-2480 MHz. Power is conducted at the chip's RF port – the gain of the T-Display's antenna is not stated by LILYGO. No EU declaration of conformity, RoHS or REACH statement for the T-Display found on lilygo.cc, in github.com/Xinyuan-LilyGO/TTGO-T-Display or by web search (2026-10-26).

hints: The 5V pin is USB VBUS behind the module's 1N5819 (D2, 1 A); with a LiPo on the module it carries the battery voltage through Q5 instead.
IO36-IO39 are input-only, without internal pulls; IO12/IO15/IO2 are strapping pins.
sources: LILYGO pin map 'ESP32 TTGO T-Display V1.1' (image/pinmap.jpg): left row GND GND 21 22 17 2 15 13 12 GND GND 3V3, right row 3V3 36 37 38 39 32 33 25 26 27 GND 5V, USB at the bottom

LILYGO schematic ESP32-TFT(6-26): header P4 = 5V GND IO27 IO26 IO25 IO33 IO32 IO39 IO38 IO37 IO36 3V3 (pins 1-12), P5 = 3V3 GND GND IO12 IO13 IO15 IO2 IO17 IO22 IO21 GND GND; +5V = VBUS through 1N5819 (D2) or VBAT through SI2307 (Q5); 3V3 from AP2112K-3.3 (U7, 600 mA, dropout 250 mV at 600 mA)

KiCad footprint TTGO-T-Display.kicad_mod and Eagle TTGO-TDisplay.lbr (LILYGO repository): rows 22.86 mm apart, pitch 2.54 mm, board 25.09 × 51.49 mm, first pin 15.93 mm from the USB end – same order as the pin map
ESP32 datasheet: VIH 0.75 VDD, VIL 0.25 VDD, I/O at most VDD + 0.3 V = 3.6 V, input-only GPIO34-39, strapping pins MTDI (IO12), MTDO (IO15), IO2
i_core_a 0.08 A (ESP32 without WiFi plus display backlight): assumption
gpio_r_out_ohm 30 Ω and gpio_i_max_a 20 mA (default drive strength): assumption from the ESP32 datasheet (40 mA at the strongest setting)
vin_min 3.6 V: AP2112K needs about 3.3 V + dropout; assumption

EasyEDA: a device created through the API cannot be placed in the local client (GET_DEVICE: 'Device details data does not exist'); the stand-in C18722937 (2541FV-2x12P, symbol pins 1-24, prefix U) is placed, and its project copies are rebuilt – like pytree's RP2350-Zero (2026-10-26)
notes: Plugged into two 1x12 female headers (hand-soldered). The LCSC number is a stand-in: the 2x12 female header C18722937 gives the EasyEDA device; variants/esp32/hardware/lib/tdisplay_device.py rebuilds its symbol and footprint copies in the project into the T-Display's (pins below, 2 x 12 pads 22.86 mm apart). The footprint keeps the header's name (D-13).
